scientific_integrity: The proof uses an explicit all-prime exponent-support classification; finite checks corroborate only the tested primes. No independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the fixed smooth quartic for primes >= 5; provides p-rank, a-number and Newton slopes, not complete zeta functions; Brock 1993 thesis not inspected; superspecial endpoint already known.
title: Hasse–Witt and Newton strata of the 48-symmetry plane quartic in every characteristic at least five
